items.title: Ocean heat waves linked with poorer health among children in coastal communities
items.summary: Marine heat waves—periods of abnormally warm ocean temperatures—may have negative health effects on children who live in coastal communities in low- and middle-income countries, according to a study led by researchers at Penn State and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

items.title: Warmer waters, pest species and habitat loss major threats to small, rare freshwater fish
items.summary: One of Australia's most comprehensive assessments of endemic, rare or threatened freshwater fish has found numerous species are at severe risk of extinction because of multiple threats, including habitat loss, invasive species and warmer waters.
